items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix, and the vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, arbitrary code execution via stored XSS, and multiple incorrect authorization flaws. Exploitation of CVE-2026-71362 requires no existing account or administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to private customer data. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield reportedly blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
